name: Front Lever
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip and start in an active hang with straight arms and depressed shoulder blades.
Brace your abdomen and press the bar toward your hips to lift your shoulders, hips and feet together into a horizontal line.
Keep your arms completely locked, legs straight together, and hips in line with your shoulders.
Hold the horizontal position steadily for the target duration, then lower your body smoothly back to a controlled hang.
tips: Keep your elbows locked straight and drive the bar downward with your lats instead of bending your arms.
Avoid piking at the hips or letting your lower back sag by squeezing your abs and glutes tightly.
